body.en:
Question B-006-010-010.

Why the correct answer is right: A high-frequency mobile vertical is usually physically short compared with a quarter wavelength, so it has capacitive reactance. A loading coil supplies inductive reactance to tune out that capacitance.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "To lower the losses": A loading coil is not installed to reduce loss; real coils add resistance, so the design goal is resonance rather than lower loss.
- sourceIndex 2: "To lower the Q": Short loaded mobile antennas often have high Q and narrow bandwidth. The coil is present to add inductance, not to lower Q.
- sourceIndex 3: "To filter out electrical noise": Noise filtering is done with suppression, bonding, chokes, or receiver filtering. The loading coil is part of the antenna tuning system.
